## Checklist

- [ ] `./mvnw verify` passes in `backend/` (it also validates every file in `questions/`)
- [ ] `npm run lint && npm run test:ci` pass in `frontend/` (if the frontend changed)

- [ ] An architecturally significant decision has an ADR in `docs/adr/`
